tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[$\Delta $-complex structure on $S^n$] ↗ lem:boundary-composition-zero 1. ch2:2.5\group Singular Homology

Glue two copies $U,L$ of $\Delta ^n$ along their boundaries by the identity. Then $\ker \partial _n=\mathbb {Z}\langle U-L\rangle $, so $H_n^\Delta (S^n)\cong \mathbb {Z}$ for this structure. \end{example}
